data.name: Date Night Neon Glow Clear Kayak or Paddleboard & Champagne Orlando
data.headline: A romantic neon-lit night paddle with clear kayaks or paddleboards, complimentary champagne, and stunning Orlando city views.
data.description:
Enjoy a relaxed and romantic evening on the water with our Date Night Neon Glow Clear Kayak or Paddleboard & Champagne experience in Orlando. After a brief check-in and safety overview, you’ll launch onto calm waters as soft neon under-glow lighting illuminates your clear kayak or paddleboard.

Your guide leads the group at an easy pace, allowing time to sip complimentary champagne, take photos, and enjoy peaceful city reflections under the night sky. No paddling experience is required, making this the perfect choice for couples celebrating anniversaries, special occasions, or simply looking for a unique and memorable night out.

highlight_box.title: Romantic Neon Glow Date Night on the Water
highlight_box.description: A peaceful neon-lit paddle designed for couples, featuring clear kayaks or paddleboards, champagne, and a relaxed Orlando night on the water.

data.highlights:
This experience is designed specifically for couples, offering a peaceful alternative to crowded nightlife or loud attractions. The neon lighting is subtle and elegant, enhancing the clear kayaks and water reflections without overwhelming the natural nighttime ambiance.

Paddling at night creates a sense of calm and intimacy that’s hard to find elsewhere in Orlando. With smooth water, gentle pacing, and thoughtful guidance, the focus stays on connection rather than performance.

Champagne adds a celebratory touch, making this a favorite for anniversaries, proposals, birthdays, and “just because” date nights.

No prior paddling experience is needed — this tour is about enjoying the moment, not mastering a skill.
data.itinerary:
1. Check-In & Setup – Meet your guide, gear fitting, and safety briefing

2. Sunset Launch – Enter the water as evening light fades

3. Neon Glow Paddle – Relaxed guided paddle with champagne and photo moments

4. Return to Shore – Easy paddle back under the city lights

meeting_point.address: 1600 North Orange Avenue Orlando, FL US 32804

data.cancellation_summary: Refund or credit available with 24 hour notice
data.cancellation_notes: Customers are eligible for a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. In the case of inclement weather, we will first try to reschedule. If a reschedule is not available, customers are eligible to receive a full refund or credit for operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. We do our best to accommodate all guests, however we cannot hold tours for late arrivals. Refunds will not be given due to guests being late for a tour or rental, or going to the incorrect location from the one displayed on the confirmation details. No-shows will be charged the full price and not eligible for refunds.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
- Guests can wear a bathing suit or workout attire
- Bring a towel and change of clothing for after the tour.
- Our guides work hard to provide an amazing experience for each of our guests. If you enjoy your time with us, please consider a tip. It is so much appreciated!

##Where to meet
Please meet your guide at the boat ramp 30 mins prior to tour start time. This will give you time to deal with traffic issues, find parking, use the restroom, and meet your guide(s). Self parking is free along NE Ivanhoe Blvd and Orange Ave, or wherever street parking is available in the area. Out of respect for our guests, we do our best to start our tours at tour time. We can not hold tours for late guests.
data.check_in_details: Please arrive 15 minutes early to allow time for check-in and equipment setup. Late arrivals may miss the tour and are not guaranteed accommodation.
data.special_requirements:
A valid photo ID is required at check-in

Participants must be able to sit independently and paddle safely

Couples and individual guests are welcome
data.restrictions:
Not suitable for guests with significant mobility impairments that prevent safe paddling or boarding

Guests must be able to enter and exit the kayak or paddleboard with minimal assistance

This experience takes place at night and may not be suitable for guests uncomfortable on the water after dark
data.disclaimers:
This experience is weather- and water-condition dependent and may be modified, delayed, or canceled for safety reasons. Route, lighting visibility, and overall experience may vary due to environmental conditions.

Epic Paddle Adventures is not responsible for personal items brought on the water. Guests participate at their own risk and must follow all guide instructions for safety.
data.faqs:
Do I need paddling experience?
No. This tour is beginner-friendly and paced slowly. Your guide provides a safety briefing and leads the group throughout the experience.
Can I choose between a kayak or paddleboard?
Yes. You select either a clear kayak or paddleboard during booking, based on availability.
Is champagne included?
Yes. Complimentary champagne is included for guests 21 and over with valid ID.
What should I wear?
Wear athletic attire, shorts, or light layers. Closed-toe water shoes or sandals with straps are recommended.
Can I bring a phone or camera?
Yes, but we recommend using a waterproof case or dry storage. Complimentary photos are provided after the tour.
What happens if the weather is bad?
Tours may be delayed, modified, or canceled due to weather or water conditions. Safety always comes first.
Is this experience good for proposals or anniversaries?
Yes. This tour is a popular choice for proposals, anniversaries, and special celebrations. If you’re planning a proposal, please let us know in advance so we can help create a smooth, memorable moment.
Can you help coordinate a proposal?
We’re happy to offer light coordination, such as timing, photo moments, or positioning on the water. Please contact us ahead of time for any special requests.

Can I choose between a kayak or paddleboard?
Yes. You select either a clear kayak or paddleboard at booking, based on availability.
What should I wear?
Wear athletic clothing, shorts, or light layers. Closed-toe water shoes or sandals with straps are recommended.
What happens if weather conditions aren’t ideal?
For safety, tours may be modified, delayed, or canceled due to weather or water conditions.
